title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (Helm + Terraform)
author: Samir Gupta
description:
Motivation: Private installer customers require an automated, idempotent RBAC bootstrap that establishes tenant-scoped roles, service accounts, and minimal cluster permissions during install/upgrade. This PR implements a Helm+Terraform-friendly automation flow that: (1) provides audited role templates for tenant isolation, (2) exposes a bootstrap script for air-gapped/on-prem environments, (3) integrates with the existing Private installer Terraform module, and (4) adds upgrade/rollback hooks to avoid privilege drift.

What changed: consolidated role templates under helm/redwood-private/templates/tenant-rbac.yaml; added Terraform resource module terraform/modules/private-installer/tenant_bootstrap.tf to optionally provision cluster roles and rolebindings when customers opt-in; included installer/scripts/bootstrap_rbac.sh for environments without direct Terraform connectivity (script performs dry-run, apply, and idempotent retries); added integration tests and docs.

Checklist:
- [x] Helm templates for tenant roles and SA creation
- [x] Terraform module with toggle and migration plan
- [x] Installer script for on-prem bootstrap path
- [x] Integration tests covering bootstrap, upgrade, and rollback
- [x] Security review and least-privilege validation

Compatibility notes: The Terraform module is backwards-compatible and gated behind a new boolean variable enable_tenant_rbac_bootstrap (default: false). The Helm chart adds a topo-scoped ServiceAccount annotation that Private installer will populate at runtime. Upgrade path: the PR includes a migration job (helm hook) that will perform a dry-run and create missing rolebindings; rollback will remove only resources created by the migration job.

Operations: the bootstrap emits audit events and a status ConfigMap (redwood.io/tenant-rbac-status) so installers can confirm success. The script and module both return idempotent exit codes to make them safe for retrying during automated installs.

References: ENG-4123 (design), ENG-4267 (security review), SUP-7821 (customer request), docs/private/tenant-rbac.md for operator guidance.

review_comments: Aisha Patel: Please tighten the ClusterRole rules to remove wildcard verbs; prefer explicit verbs for token creation and secret access.
Samir Gupta (author): Updated ClusterRole to explicit verbs and added unit tests to validate allowed verbs (see last commit).
María López: Can we make the terraform toggle opt-out at workspace level instead of chart-level? Concern about accidental privilege grants during automated runs.
Samir Gupta (author): Added an override variable 'workspace_enable_tenant_rbac_bootstrap' and documented how the installer sets it; default remains false.
Jordan Kim: Integration tests flaky on first run (timing). Suggest adding readiness wait and idempotency assertions.
Samir Gupta (author): Improved test harness with readiness probe waits and deterministic resource name generation; re-ran CI.
release_notes: Adds automated tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (Helm + Terraform). Introduces opt-in terraform module, idempotent installer script for air-gapped installs, migration hook for upgrades, and integration tests. Default behavior is opt-out; enabling requires explicit opt-in in installer variables.
